title: Provider-Agnostic PR/CI Security Gate (V2.10 + V3 Block 1 "CI Security Gate 2.0")
description: Reference shapes for scripts/pr_gate.py's two output modes (docs/decisiones.md D-065, D-06X). This script NEVER makes a network call, NEVER holds credentials, and NEVER posts a comment/annotation/commit status itself - it is provider-agnostic by construction (nothing here names a specific Git hosting provider). It reuses ingest_onchain.build_bundle() and diff_reports.diff_reports()/score.compute_stable_key UNCHANGED. V3 Block 1 added policy.minConfidence/policy.blockingCategories (both optional) and two opt-in CLI flags (--strict-exit, --format text) documented in pr_gate.py's own module docstring - the result SHAPE below is otherwise byte-for-byte the V2.10 shape.

ingestResult.description: G1. Output of ingest_pr_changed_files() / CLI mode 'ingest'.

refLabel.description: Opaque caller-supplied label (e.g. 'base'/'head' or a real SHA) - never parsed or validated as a real git ref.

bundle.description: preprocess.py-ready multi-file bundle text, or null when zero files were accepted (e.g. an empty PR).

skippedFiles.description: Reused verbatim from ingest_onchain.build_bundle() - malicious paths, duplicates, and bundle-marker-injection attempts are recorded here, never silently dropped.

gateResult.description: G2+G3+G4. Output of evaluate_pr_gate() / CLI mode 'gate'.

policy.description: minConfidence/blockingCategories (V3 Block 1) are OPTIONAL narrowing filters, present in this echoed-back object only when the caller supplied them - omitting both reproduces the exact V2.10 policy shape and gate decision.

blockingSeverities.description: Always an explicit caller input, echoed back verbatim (de-duplicated) - never hardcoded, never guessed.

minConfidence.description: V3 Block 1, optional. Only present if the caller set it. A newFinding is excluded from blocking only if its OWN confidence is a recognized value below this rank - a missing/unrecognized confidence on a finding is never treated as a free pass.

blockingCategories.description: V3 Block 1, optional. Only present if the caller set it. Each item must be one of preprocess.CATEGORIES's own keys (the SC01-SC10 taxonomy plus its supplementary EXTRA-* checks) - deliberately not enumerated here as a fixed list, since preprocess.CATEGORIES is the single source of truth and a second, hardcoded copy of its keys would drift as categories are added there.

diff.description: The UNMODIFIED output of diff_reports.diff_reports() (see version-diff-reports-schema.json / D-054) - newFindings/resolvedFindings/modifiedFindings, categoryCoverageDelta, etc.

blockingFindingCount.description: Count of diff.newFindings whose severity is in policy.blockingSeverities. resolvedFindings/modifiedFindings are NEVER counted here.

annotations.description: G4. Built from ALL diff.newFindings (not only blocking ones) so a CI comment can surface everything new, not just what fails the build. Purely structured - no free-text field, no source/diff reproduction.

businessRules: R-G1: ingest_pr_changed_files() reuses ingest_onchain.build_bundle() UNCHANGED - path sanitization, duplicate rejection, and bundle-marker-injection rejection are never re-derived, since a PR's changed files are exactly as untrusted as explorer-sourced files.
R-G2: evaluate_pr_gate()'s diff field is the UNMODIFIED output of diff_reports.diff_reports() (V2.5/D-054) - this module never re-implements finding matching/stableKey logic.

R-G3: The gate decision (gateStatus/blockingFindingCount) considers ONLY diff.newFindings. resolvedFindings and modifiedFindings describe the baseline's own pre-existing history and NEVER affect the gate. policy.blockingSeverities is a REQUIRED, explicit caller input - this module has no hardcoded threshold and no code path that invents one.

R-G4: annotations[] contains ONLY structured, bounded fields (file/lineStart/lineEnd/contract/function/severity/category/stableKey) - it NEVER includes a finding's free-text description/evidence/recommendation/patch fields or any reproduction of source/diff content, so an embedded secret can never be echoed into a PR comment/annotation built from it.

R-G5: This module makes no network/API calls, holds no credentials, and posts nothing itself - permissions/authentication, retries/timeouts/rate limits, and the actual comment/annotation/commit-status API calls are entirely the calling CI workflow's responsibility.

R-G6: A PASS gateStatus is never proof of safety - it only reflects what this comparison, under the caller's own policy, could determine from the two reports it was given (see NEVER_SAFE_BY_SILENCE_NOTE).

R-G7 (V3 Block 1): policy.minConfidence/policy.blockingCategories only ever NARROW which severity-matching newFindings count as blocking - they never add a new check, never change a finding's own severity/confidence/category, and an unrecognized policy key or an invalid value for a recognized key raises an error rather than being silently ignored (fail closed, never fail open).

R-G8 (V3 Block 1): the CLI's default behavior (no --strict-exit, no --format) is byte-for-byte the V2.10 behavior - a FAIL gateStatus still exits EXIT_OK unless --strict-exit is explicitly passed, and --format defaults to json.
